description: Single-Spark NVIDIA Kimodo job: a text prompt becomes a 30 fps human motion on the SOMA skeleton, from Kimodo-SOMA-RP-v1.2 with the creator's own generator and its default diffusion steps and guidance. The text encoder is LLM2Vec (two McGill NLP adapters on Meta-Llama-3-8B-Instruct, about 17 GB together with the motion model). The output is one motion.zip holding motion.bvh (somaskel77 skeleton, centimetres, standard T-pose rest pose) and motion.npz, meant for retargeting in Blender; the artifact contract has no animation format, so a skinned GLB clip is not offered. The duration is a setting; every sentence of the prompt becomes its own segment of that duration. Foot-skate post-processing is off, because upstream's MotionCorrection is x86-only C++. The model is released under the NVIDIA Open Model License and the text encoder's base under the Meta Llama 3 Community License. Physical Spark acceptance is pending.
title: Kimodo SOMA RP v1.2 pytorch-pipeline single Spark
